acceptanceCriteria: Shared discovery test helpers build on windows or move to a *_unix_test.go file with a comment
Windows vet over internal/testvaliditydoc passes with a new unconstrained test using the portable helpers
body: Lane V1-1797 (PR #1135) added a test in internal/testvaliditydoc using discover_test.go helpers; GOOS=windows go vet failed because those helpers carry a darwin||linux build constraint, and the lane had to split the test into a constrained file. Expected: shared test helpers either build on all platforms or live in a clearly named constrained helper file so the constraint is obvious.
title: testvaliditydoc discover_test.go helpers are darwin||linux only, so new tests using them silently break Windows vet
